title: Legion of Substitute Heroes Special #1 DC 1985 Keith Giffen Karl Kesel Cover
condition_description: Chip at the lower-right front corner, edge wear and small chips along the back cover's left edge, light toning and a light stain on the back. See close-ups.
description:
The Legion of Substitute Heroes Special #1 (DC Comics, July 1985), one-shot humor special. Cover by Keith Giffen and Karl Kesel with the "You really expect us to get people to PAY for this?" memo gag. Polar Boy, Night Girl, Fire Lad, Chlorophyll Kid, Stone Boy and company. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Kenner Super Powers Collection action figures ad.

Condition: chip at the lower-right front corner, edge wear and small chips along the left edge of the back cover, light toning and a light stain on the back (see close-ups).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
